baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction `la uqsimu bi-yawmi al-qiyamah` is anchored in the focus verb, temporal noun, and resurrection noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus joins an oath-taking speech act to a day understood as a severe occurrence and to bodily rising at the Resurrection; the named day is therefore an event of standing, not merely a calendar label.

activation_trace.role: Oath-taking, including a juridical oath procedure, supplies the solemn speech act that opens the ayah.
A day as a major or severe occurrence makes the oath-object an event rather than only a unit of time.
Resurrection and creatures rising before their Lord specifies the event named by al-qiyamah.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely swears by a future date called the Day of Resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The ayah performs a solemn oath by the severe event in which creatures rise and stand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The model remains attached to `uqsimu` and `al-qiyamah` through non-dominant images within their own focus-root inventories.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the ordinary oath sense, the focus roots place apportionment beside valuation and equal measure. This permits a faint focus-only resonance of the Resurrection as an occasion that assigns shares and renders an exact appraisal.

activation_trace.role: Dividing a thing and allotting its shares supplies the distributive side of the focus verb's root network.
The event-day provides the occasion on which the proposed distribution and appraisal occur.
Value, appraisal, and pricing supply an evaluative image within the root of al-qiyamah.
Equal weight and even measure sharpen appraisal into exact measure.

changed_reading.before: The oath verb and the name of the Resurrection contribute only their conventional senses.
changed_reading.after: Their root inventories also allow a contained resonance of a day of allotted outcomes and exact valuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated oath construction pairs the public event of rising with an inward self that reproaches. The first oath is revised from an isolated assertion into the outer half of a two-sided evidentiary frame: cosmic disclosure and internal moral testimony.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath supplies the first solemn assertion in the pair.
The severe event-day supplies the outward and public side of the paired witness structure.
Collective rising before the Lord anchors the public event in the focus noun.
The same oath image repeats immediately and makes the two objects formally parallel.
The self as the very identity of a thing supplies an inward witness that cannot be detached from the person.
Deserved blame gives that inward witness its evaluative and accusatory force.

structural_cues: 75:1-2 repeat the same `la uqsimu bi-` frame in adjacent clauses.
The paired objects move from a universal event to the person's own reproaching self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two parallel oaths, one to the Resurrection and one to the reproaching self; I infer that they function as outer and inner witnesses. They may alternatively be two independent oath objects without an evidentiary division of labor.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a standalone oath establishing the reality of resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the public half of a paired testimony in which the event and the self jointly expose the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The apportioning image latent in the focus verb is answered by one gathering root repeated across body, cosmos, and recitation. The Day of Rising can therefore be heard, at the level of root resonance, as the occasion that reverses dispersal by collecting separated material, lights, and discourse.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning and separating into shares supplies the focus-side image of dispersion.
Resurrection and rising anchor the proposed reversal in al-qiyamah rather than in an independent theme.
Joining what was scattered supplies material gathering at the level of the bones.
The same joining image expands gathering from the body to the sun and moon.
The same joining image extends gathering to the recited discourse itself.

structural_cues: The same gathering lexeme recurs at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 for body, cosmos, and recitation.
Each recurrence collects constituents that can otherwise be conceived as separate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus-root image of partition and three explicit gatherings; I infer a cross-domain reversal from division to collection. The live alternative is that the oath sense excludes the partition image and the three gatherings are locally independent.

changed_reading.before: The focus oath names resurrection without an internal material operation.
changed_reading.after: The oath faintly announces a Day whose recurring operation is to gather what has been separated across body, cosmos, and speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus noun's bodily rising is made mechanically explicit: dispersed hard structure is joined, capacity is asserted, the body is restored to integral upright form, and even its extremities are included. Resurrection becomes exact re-standing rather than generic return.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily rising supplies the physical action latent in al-qiyamah.
Resurrection and creatures rising before their Lord fixes that bodily action to the focus event.
Joining scattered matter supplies the first operation required for bodily re-standing.
Hard bone identifies the durable but dispersed bodily framework being gathered.
Effective capacity supplies the enabling power for the reconstruction.
Integrity and upright completeness supply the resulting condition of the reconstructed body.
The fingertips and bodily extremities make the claimed restoration exact rather than approximate.

structural_cues: 75:3 poses denial of bone-gathering and 75:4 answers it with an emphatic affirmative and a finer bodily detail.
The sequence moves from skeleton to the body's smallest named extremities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bones, joining, capacity, bodily completion, and fingertips; I infer that these are the operations by which the focus-root's rising body is made to stand again. They may alternatively function only as evidence of power without unpacking al-qiyamah itself.

changed_reading.before: Al-qiyamah denotes resurrection in a general or conventional way.
changed_reading.after: Al-qiyamah names an exact bodily re-standing whose integrity reaches from gathered bones to fingertips.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic gathering closes outward space; attempted flight finds no refuge and terminates at the Lord's fixed settlement. The sequence then turns inward through a delivered report, self-sight, and ineffective excuses. The focus day becomes an inescapable funnel from universal convergence to personal audit.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day anchors every stage of the funnel in the focus temporal object.
A standing-place or station lets the focus noun receive the later image of an unavoidable settlement.
Valuation supplies the audit function performed once movement ends.
Joining the separated sun and moon begins the spatial collapse into convergence.
Flight supplies the person's attempted counter-motion away from convergence.
The denied refuge removes any terminal shelter for that attempted flight.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the authority toward whom the closed movement runs.
Fixity and settlement end flight at an unavoidable terminus.
A delivered report turns arrival into disclosure of the person's record.
The self as one's very identity makes the object of disclosure inseparable from the witness.
Inner insight supplies self-recognition after the external report.
Excuse-making supplies the failed attempt to resist the completed audit.

structural_cues: 75:9-15 runs without a scene break from cosmic conjunction through failed escape and fixed destination to report, self-sight, and excuses.
Repeated `yawma'idh` expressions keep the spatial and juridical stages inside the day named in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies convergence, failed flight, no refuge, fixed arrival, report, self-insight, and excuses; I infer a funnel whose endpoint is audit. The live alternative is that these are successive consequences of the day rather than the mechanism carried by the focus phrase itself.

changed_reading.before: The Day of Resurrection is primarily a moment when the dead rise.
changed_reading.after: It is a closed movement toward sovereign settlement where outward escape collapses into inwardly undeniable audit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening first-person oath is retrospectively placed inside a governed delivery sequence: premature tongue-motion is stopped, collection and recitation are assigned to the speaker, following is ordered, and clarification is guaranteed. `Uqsimu` thus functions not only as assertion but as a deliberately delivered unit of authoritative recitation.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch anchors the model in the focus's voiced first-person speech act.
Motion opposed to stillness supplies the bodily action that is explicitly restrained during reception.
The tongue as speech organ locates the restrained motion in verbal delivery.
Haste and premature advancement identify the delivery failure being blocked.
Joining what is dispersed supplies the first speaker-controlled stage of the discourse.
Reading and recitation supply the authoritative vocal stage after collection.
Following after another assigns the recipient a responsive rather than initiating role.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign completes the sequence with speaker-guaranteed clarification.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 orders restraint, collection, recitation, following, and clarification.
The repeated `alayna` assigns collection and clarification to the same first-person authority heard in `uqsimu`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a controlled sequence for receiving and voicing the discourse; I infer that it retroactively frames the opening oath as a governed recited act. It may alternatively be a local instruction whose delivery mechanics do not alter the oath's reading.

changed_reading.before: `Uqsimu` is an isolated rhetorical oath whose force lies only in its object.
changed_reading.after: `Uqsimu` is also heard as a precisely governed utterance within a sequence of collection, recitation, following, and clarification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love fixes the heart on what is advanced and immediate, while the later reality is left behind. The focus's event-day is therefore not neutral future chronology; the oath installs a counter-horizon intended to break an affective preference for immediacy.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time lets the focus day operate as a temporal horizon rather than only a date.
The severe future occurrence gives that horizon decisive weight against the immediate present.
Resurrection supplies the deferred reality being brought into present attention.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the motive that selects one temporal horizon over another.
Haste and advancement supply the attraction of what arrives first.
Leaving a thing supplies the active abandonment of the competing later horizon.
Laterness after what comes first defines the horizon that is being abandoned.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 forms an explicit `rather` contrast between loving the immediate and leaving the later.
The focus places the later event before the reader before the surah diagnoses the preference against it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an affective choice between immediate and later; I infer that the opening oath works as temporal reorientation toward the neglected horizon. The alternative is that 75:20-21 diagnoses the audience without modifying the oath's function.

changed_reading.before: The oath points descriptively to a future day.
changed_reading.after: The oath actively counters a heart-level preference for the immediate by making the neglected later horizon present and weighty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The body reaches its limit, undergoes separation, loses free legged motion as limb wraps against limb, and is driven toward the Lord. Against that sequence, the focus's bodily rising becomes a reversal of failed self-support: the one who can no longer carry himself is conveyed to the standing that he cannot evade.

activation_trace.role: Bodily rising and upright standing supply the posture that the death sequence will reverse and restore.
Stoppage and exhaustion expose the contrary state from which resurrection-standing emerges.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the body's terminal boundary.
Separation between two things supplies the decisive rupture at that boundary.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the body's constricted loss of independent movement.
The paired legs identify the bodily supports that are no longer carrying the person freely.
Driving and propulsion replace self-directed movement with imposed conveyance toward the Lord.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 progresses from a bodily limit through separation and entangled legs to conveyance toward the Lord.
The repeated leg/driving root turns one bodily image into a change of agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terminal arrival, separation, wrapped legs, and driving; I infer a reversal from failed self-standing to imposed standing before the Lord. The scene may alternatively be only a prelude to resurrection rather than an internal coloring of al-qiyamah.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection-standing begins only after death as a separate future event.
changed_reading.after: The focus standing is approached through death's collapse of self-support and the person's unavoidable conveyance to a new standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending traces an initial measured substance through creative measuring and integral formation, then asks whether the same effective capacity can restore life after its loss. The focus resurrection is thereby modeled as the completion or repetition of a demonstrated production sequence, not an arbitrary interruption of nature.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and rising supply the endpoint to be explained by the creation sequence.
Uprightness and integral evenness supply the formal condition produced in both formation and re-formation.
Generative fluid from which formation is measured supplies the sequence's small material beginning.
Measuring and proportioning supply the design operation in first formation.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the transition from measure to actual body.
Integral upright completion supplies the finished state of formation.
Effective capacity links the demonstrated first formation to the proposed reanimation.
Possession of living spirit supplies the state restored at the end of the sequence.
Loss of power and life supplies the condition that reanimation reverses.

structural_cues: 75:37-40 moves in a causal sequence from generative fluid to formed body and then to the question of reviving the dead.
The closing capability question answers the opening focus by returning explicitly to resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured generation, creation, completion, effective capacity, life, and death; I infer that the same production logic carries from first formation to re-formation. The live alternative is that first creation proves power analogically without describing resurrection's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks acceptance of resurrection as a singular future miracle.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the culminating re-formation in a measured life-cycle whose first formation the surah makes observable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because `uqsimu` is morphologically an oath, while facial beauty and apportionment are distant branches of its root. It remains anchored because both branches belong to the focus root and the context explicitly divides that day's faces into radiant and grim sets. Downstream prose should present it only as a compositional root resonance, never as an alternative translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to `uqsimu` through the focus root's images of apportioned beauty across a face and division into shares.

activation_trace.role: Beauty apportioned across a face supplies the unusually exact bridge to the later facial scene.
Division into shares supplies the mechanism by which opposed visible outcomes are distributed.
The event-day keeps the facial distribution tied to the focus oath-object.
The face as visible front supplies the surface on which one outcome appears.
Radiant beauty supplies the positive facial share.
The repeated face creates a second recipient class on the same visible surface.
A grimace of intense aversion supplies the opposed facial share.

changed_reading.before: The root of `uqsimu` contributes only oath-taking to the focus.
changed_reading.after: At a contained resonant level, it anticipates a day that apportions opposed outcomes visibly across faces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from `ل و م` to `ل م م`, so the gathering image is form-distant from the ordinary blame sense. It remains valid as an activation because the supplied split branch immediately precedes explicit bone-gathering and attaches back to the focus root's apportionment image and al-qiyamah. Downstream prose should label it a split-root echo or hinge, not gloss `lawwamah` as gathering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to the focus tension between `uqsimu` as apportioning in its root network and `al-qiyamah` as resurrection after dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning and separating into shares supplies one side of the proposed hinge.
Resurrection anchors the hinge in the focus event that gathers life after dispersal.
The non-dominant split target supplies an image of collecting and joining what was scattered.
Explicitly joining scattered bones makes the split-root gathering image locally consequential rather than free-floating.

changed_reading.before: The two opening oaths simply name resurrection and moral self-reproach.
changed_reading.after: A faint split-root hinge lets the second oath mediate between the focus's apportionment resonance and the immediate promise to gather scattered bones.

strongest_changes: The repeated oath recasts 75:1 as the public half of a paired outer-and-inner testimony.
Repeated gathering across bones, celestial bodies, and recitation gives the focus day a cross-domain operation of collecting what was separated.
The no-refuge sequence turns resurrection into forced convergence at a fixed sovereign audit where report and self-insight defeat excuses.
The final measured-creation sequence makes resurrection an exact re-formation continuous with demonstrated first formation.
The recitation instructions and the immediate-versus-later contrast make the opening oath both a governed utterance and an affective temporal intervention.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activation came from non-oath branches of the focus root `ق س م`: apportionment cohered with repeated gathering, while apportioned facial beauty aligned precisely with the opposed faces of 75:22-24. The packet's non-dominant `ل و م` to `ل م م` mapping also supplied a carefully contained gathering hinge at the opening.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supplies no branch inventory for the particle `la`, so its exact syntactic force remains outside the branch trace.
The apportionment, facial-beauty, and split-root gathering readings are compositional resonances, not secure alternate lexical senses of the surface forms.
The reconstruction and first-creation passages may prove the possibility of al-qiyamah without defining its internal mechanism.
The delivery instructions may frame only 75:16-19 locally rather than retroactively governing the opening oath.
